variants.specifics: Three townsfolk point at Ulric's wolf bounty, Wenna's seal stolen by the Urchins, and Red Corwin on Crow Hill.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Wolves out of the Ashwood took half of Ulric's sheep! The old shepherd's offering a bounty, I hear.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Poor Wenna! Those Urchins from the old barrow stole her husband's seal right out of the mill!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Red Corwin's bandits hold the old watchtower on Crow Hill. Nobody takes the north road now!

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at Dunlin's leeches in the Bracken, Mabry's scales taken by a Troll, and Dunstan's hammer at the Hanging Oak.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Don't wade in the Bracken! Giant Leeches have the shallows, and Dunlin the ferryman's paying to be rid of them!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Mabry's in tears! A Troll under the old stone bridge took her silver scales!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Corwin's men robbed Dunstan's cart by the Hanging Oak. Took his grandfather's hammer, too! He's furious!

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at Pip lost in the barrow, Greyjaw at the Ashwood's edge, and the tithe chest Corwin's bandits stole.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Brother Anselm's novice, young Pip, went after the Urchins in the old barrow. He hasn't come back!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: I saw Greyjaw at the edge of the Ashwood! A wolf as big as a pony! Ulric wants him dead.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Corwin's bandits stole the town's tithe chest! The Reeve is beside himself.

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at Corrie's hunt for the bear Old Scratch, Ossian's lantern stolen by the Urchins, and Corwin's lookouts on Crow Hill.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: A bear mauled Corrie's brother by the berry thickets! She's hunting the brute they call Old Scratch.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Have you seen the Drowned Lantern's door? Dark! The Urchins pinched Ossian's brass lantern!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Corwin's lookouts watch the north road from the tower on Crow Hill. Someone ought to throw them off it!

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at Hebb's spider-ridden charcoal pits, Mother Gale's ring lost to a leech, and Garrick's father's horn on Crow Hill.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Hebb came running out of the Ashwood all covered in web! Spiders have taken his charcoal pits!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Mother Gale lost her wedding ring to a leech! Down in the reeds below the mill, of all places!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: That horn at night? It was Garrick's father's! Corwin's men blow it on Crow Hill to mock us.

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at the bats in the chapel bell tower, the Reeve's chain stolen by the Urchins, and Corwin's black wolves on the north road.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: The chapel bell has gone quiet! Bats from the barrow nest in the tower, and Brother Anselm can't get them out.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Have you seen the Reeve's bare neck? The Urchins stole his chain of office! Heh, heh!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Corwin looses black wolves on the north road at night. Garrick has a bounty on them!

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at Tam's rats in the mill cellar, Ulric's crook by the wolves' den, and Sly Wat who knows Corwin's tower.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Wenna's boy Tam swears the rats in the mill cellar are as big as dogs! He's offering a reward.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Old Ulric dropped his father's crook running from the wolves. It's out by their den in the Ashwood!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Sly Wat used to ride with Red Corwin. Buy him a drink at the Drowned Lantern, and he might talk about the watchtower!

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at the wasps in Elsa's orchard, Wenna's stolen seal, and Red Corwin robbing the north road.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Elsa's orchard is crawling with wasps! Their Queen is as big as a crow, she says!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Wenna's flour has no mark on it now. The Urchins crept out of the barrow and stole her seal!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Corwin's bandits took my brother's mule on the north road! I'd give a lot to see Red Corwin swing.

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at the Wisps over the Bracken, the Undead in the chapel crypt, and Corwin's men at the Hanging Oak.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Don't follow the lights on the Bracken! The Wisps lead drinkers into the river. Ossian wants them gone!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Brother Anselm saw the dead walking in the chapel crypt! He dropped his mother's beads running out!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Some of Corwin's men camp at the Hanging Oak. Dunstan wants a word with them about his hammer!

variants.specifics: Townsfolk point at the Mawweeds eating Hedda's goats, Pip gone after the chapel's candlesticks, and the shut north gate.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Hedda's goats keep vanishing in the bog west of the Ashwood. Mawweeds ate them, she says! Plants!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: The Urchins stole the candlesticks from the Chapel of the Ford! Little Pip went after them alone!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: The Reeve won't open the north gate till Red Corwin is dead. My cart's been waiting a month!
